query: Can I patent Paracetamol tablet formulations under the classical Ayurveda drug provisions?

agenerate.raw: No. Under the Drugs & Cosmetics Act the term “patent or proprietary medicine” for Ayurvedic, Siddha or Unani systems is limited to formulations that contain only ingredients listed in the authoritative books specified in the First Schedule. A paracetamol tablet does not use any such Ayurvedic ingredients, so it cannot be treated as a “patent or proprietary medicine” under the classical Ayurveda provisions [Drugs_and_Cosmetics_Act_and_Rules::p13::c7].

No. Under the Drugs & Cosmetics Act the term “patent or proprietary medicine” for Ayurvedic, Siddha or Unani systems is limited to formulations that contain **only** ingredients listed in the authoritative books specified in the First Schedule.
